history.summary: Shri Maharani Vaishno Devi Mandir on Deep Chand Bhatia Marg, New Industrial Township-1, is a Devi (Vaishno Devi/Durga) shrine with 4,100+ aggregated reviews at 4.6/5, making it the most prominent of several similarly named shrines in Faridabad. IDENTITY NOTE: the generic CSV name also matches a Vaishno Devi Mandir at East Chawla Colony, Sector 4, Ballabhgarh, and one at Adarsh Nagar, Sector 63; the NIT-1 shrine was chosen as the best-documented referent — review this mapping. Its founding year is not documented in the sources consulted. Coordinates are a high-relevance geocode match, agreeing with an independent map pin (28.384678, 77.297953). Opening hours are not reliably documented — verify before visiting.

name: Vaishno Devi Mandir
town_description: Faridabad is the largest city in Haryana and part of the National Capital Region, an industrial hub founded in 1607 by Sufi saint Sheikh Farid (Baba Farid). It lies about 25 km south of Delhi on NH-19 (Mathura Road).

travel.airport: IGI Airport, Delhi (~35 km via NH-19)
travel.road: Deep Chand Bhatia Marg, New Industrial Township-1 (NIT area); autos and city buses

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Navratri for the main festival
visitor_information.opening_hours: Hours not reliably documented (verify before visiting)
